items.title: Jane Ira Bloom interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 3, 1998
items.q: It’s fortunate that you had a piano teacher that could give you a little support in that area. Yeah. Harvey Steinberg. I’ll never forget him.

ctx.x: It’s fortunate that you had a piano teacher that could give you a little support in that area.
Yeah. Harvey Steinberg. I’ll never forget him.
Thank you Harvey. You know because too often you hear the stories about people taking piano lessons and they want to try doing their own thing and it’s like, don’t do that.
